purpose: measure the stability the single-sample arms could not report: the same 83 programs, the same cheap model, three draws each. Not a verdict, a spread.
follows: experiments/v107/e6c -- its 83 repeat-0 rows are reused from the request cache at zero calls and are the first of the three draws, not a separate arm.

deviation_from_v107.why: v1.07 argued the pre-registered pairing uses only repeat 0 and dropped the other two as a sensitivity. That is correct about the verdict and silent about the spread: every arm in this study is one draw, and none of them reports how far apart two draws fall. This arm pays for the spread at the same price.
same 83 programs, same model, same cap, same prompt, same verifier, same decision rule. Only the number of draws moved.

population: the 83 programs of the v1.06 protocol, copied and hash-checked (cases_payload_sha256 equal to that protocol's). 14 true, 69 false.
task: one call: the model states a box on the parameters; the frozen pipeline is re-run inside it; the outcome is conditional on the box and reported with the retained fraction. Prompt, system message, temperature and verifier imported from v1.05.
control: NOT RUN HERE. Reused from experiments/v106/e6b/baseline.json: 17 / 83 proved, 1481 verification attempts, 5 case TIMEOUT, and the five-case 4x-budget sensitivity in experiments/v106/e6b_sensitivity/ (0 of 5 proved at 3600 s). Copied file hash checked at freeze time.
decision_rule: unchanged from v1.06, and the code that applies it is imported, not rewritten: at each floor t in (0.0, 1e-05, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5), pair the arms on the 83 cases and compute exact McNemar over the discordant pairs; the contract arm is credited only if at EVERY rung where either arm claims anything, only-S exceeds only-B with p < 0.05.
prompt_source: scripts/spec_v105.py:prompt -- imported, not copied, and hashed above
